title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00320v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal aft

translated_title: 拒绝可定位，损害会转移：少样本微调下的安全层
translated_abstract: 微调可将经过对齐的大语言模型（LLM）适配到下游任务，但仅用几十个有害样本就能使其丧失对有害请求的拒绝能力。先前的研究将安全相关行为定位到特定的层、方向和词元上，为保护机制提供了目标。我们检验了成功的定位与恢复能否支撑起在攻击方式变化时依然有效的防御。在来自四个模型家族的六个模型检查点上，攻击后有害与良性提示仍然保持线性可分，且将完整的干净隐状态修补进受损模型后，可在一个可复现的过渡深度处恢复拒绝行为。基于先前的层冻结防御方法，我们冻结该深度之前的所有层并重复攻击。在100个有害样本下，所有六个检查点上的拒绝率仍接近于零，且恢复过渡出现在冻结边界之上。在第二项研究中，移除参数更新中排名前二的奇异方向可在攻击后恢复拒绝行为。
tldr: 研究表明，尽管大模型的安全行为可定位到特定层，但冻结这些“安全层”的防御在少样本有害微调下依然失效，损害会迁移到未冻结的层中，说明单纯的定位难以支撑鲁棒的安全防御。
